flagship_directive: Extend one-intervention exact identification and cover separation to the published fully supported Rn/C1 class, supplying a noncompact replacement for the compact conditional-rank argument.
critique: The note proves generic population identification only on the positive compact-support C3 mechanism class with C2 mixing and a global fixed-sign likelihood-ratio derivative, not on the published full-Rn/C1 class whose arbitrary-dimensional question motivated the work. Its finite-sample graph result assumes an externally supplied simultaneous ratio-estimation error event and therefore is not a complete implementable recovery guarantee. Uniform estimation of the recovered coordinates remains open under oeq:generated-rank-frontier, and exact parent pruning is entirely population-level with no conditional-independence margin or finite-sample theorem. The framing confines the intervention-count improvement and statistical limitations to their proved scope, so there is no stale claim of a matched coordinate rate or resolution of the comparator's full class.
